game.title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
game.blurb: Action-adventure from Respawn Entertainment, released 2023-04-27. RAWG average playtime: 17 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Cal Kestis and his crew, five years on, planet by planet. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Combat, Skills and Legendary Foes
chapters.summary: Force powers, stances, skill trees, perks, companions and the legendary adversaries.

chapters.title: Exploration and Puzzles
chapters.summary: Jedi Chambers, Force Tears, high points, mounts, scans and BD-1 investigations.

chapters.title: Koboh Life: Trading, Garden and Holotactics
chapters.summary: Trading collected items, filling the rooftop garden and winning holotactics.

chapters.title: Customisation
chapters.summary: Cosmetics for Cal, BD-1, the blaster and the lightsaber.

notes: No StrategyWiki page under this title. starwars.fandom.com (Wookieepedia) answers the API; the link list hit the 500-link query limit, so the true count is higher; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 23 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter. The first 13 hidden ones are listed in story order with falling unlock rates; the other 10 (for example Can You Pet the Bogling? and Skoova Diving) look like side activities and need checking.
